description: This Java class 'TSProjectConsumer' implements the 'ConfigurationConsumer' interface and handles reading, processing, and writing Tuner Studio configuration files with special handling for start and end tags and variable substitutions.

classes.name: TSProjectConsumer
classes.description: Handles processing of Tuner Studio configuration files and integration into project.

methods.name: writeTunerStudioFile
methods.description: Reads a Tuner Studio file, modifies its header information, and writes it to a new location.

methods.name: readTsFile
methods.description: Reads and extracts sections of the Tuner Studio file based on start and end tags.

methods.name: endFile
methods.description: Triggers writing the final Tuner Studio file after processing.

methods.name: handleEndStruct
methods.description: Handles final processing when a configuration structure ends, including size calculation.
